Account.et: Unadapted borrowing from English account. The alternative pronunciations are due to the fact that German has no native initial /ə/ (though in the case of /ɛ-/ perhaps also to a falsely assumed English pronunciation).

Customer Success und Account Management spielen in diesem Zusammenhang eine wesentliche Rolle.
